name: board_frame_75
prompt: A WIDE landscape slot-machine board frame seen straight on, for a premium cartoon slot game set at a night-time gas station, matching a 7-column by 5-row board: a thick polished chrome bezel with rounded corners, a glowing hot-red neon tube running all the way round just inside the chrome, small chrome rivets, a red-and-cream enamel nameplate cap with small chrome wings centred on the top edge (no text) and a matching smaller one on the bottom edge. The whole inside of the frame is EMPTY and fully transparent - a big empty wide window taking about 90% of the width and 86% of the height. Polished high-end cartoon illustration, bold black ink outlines, cel shading, glossy highlights. Fully transparent background outside the frame. No text, nothing else.
